Automate system configuration, monitoring, reporting, maintenance, log analysis, and scheduled activities. Develop custom scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive administrative tasks. Troubleshoot and modify existing automation scripts as required. review_candidates.description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 12 The Opportunity If you're an engineer who sees enterprise security not as a restriction — but as architecture — this role was built for you. We're looking for a Micro-Segmentation Engineer who can bridge the gap between application complexity and security precision — someone who doesn't just understand how networks talk, but knows exactly when they shouldn't .
